base_url.title: Base URL
base_url.description:
Base URL of your SAP system (without service path).

Examples:
• On-premise: https://my-sap-server.com
• SAP API Business Hub: https://sandbox.api.sap.com/s4hanacloud
• SAP BTP: https://my-tenant.s4hana.cloud.sap

Learn more: https://api.sap.com/

auth_type.title: Authentication Type
auth_type.description:
Choose the authentication method supported by your SAP system.

• Basic: Username and password (most common)
• OAuth 2.0: Token-based authentication
• API Key: For SAP API Business Hub and similar services

Learn more: https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_NETWEAVER_AS_ABAP_FOR_SOH_740/68bf513362174d54b58cddec28794093/e6f7c2fad4bd453eb5ee75b5d2685885.html

username.title: Username
username.description: SAP system username for basic authentication.

#password.title: Password
#password.description: SAP system password (encrypted and stored securely).

#api_key.title: API Key
#api_key.description:
API key for authentication (encrypted and stored securely).

Used with SAP API Business Hub or custom API gateways.
Get your key at: https://api.sap.com/

api_key_header_name.title: API Key Header Name
api_key_header_name.description:
HTTP header name for the API key.

Common values:
• APIKey (SAP API Business Hub)
• X-API-Key (custom gateways)
• Authorization (with 'Bearer' prefix)

timeout.title: Request Timeout (seconds)
timeout.description:
Maximum time to wait for SAP server response.

Recommended:
• 60s for most scenarios
• 120s+ for large data extractions
• 30s for API Business Hub

max_retries.title: Max Retries
max_retries.description:
Number of automatic retry attempts on transient failures (network issues, timeouts).

Recommended: 3 retries

verify_ssl.title: Verify SSL Certificates
verify_ssl.description:
Verify SSL/TLS certificates for HTTPS connections.

⚠️ Only disable for development/testing with self-signed certificates.
Production systems should always use verified certificates.

page_size.title: Default Page Size
page_size.description:
Number of records per page for all entities (can be overridden per entity).

OData uses server-side paging with $top and $skip parameters.

Recommended:
• 1000 for standard entities
• 500 for entities with many fields
• 100 for testing

Learn more: https://www.odata.org/getting-started/basic-tutorial/#queryData

max_records.title: Default Max Records
max_records.description:
Maximum total records to fetch for all entities (can be overridden per entity).

Set to 0 for unlimited extraction.
Useful for:
• Testing (e.g., 100 records)
• Cost control on metered APIs
• Development environments
